text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A twice at a gain; before taking profits again, I should check whether selling fits my target allocation and plan, rather than seeking the satisfaction of locking in gains.","I made no trades in most periods, while my account value still fluctuated. I should not trade just to react to short-term changes, but I should review risks and diversification when I check my account.","Since past price changes do not predict future moves, I should decide whether to hold, buy, or sell using current fundamentals, portfolio risk, and my long-term needs—not my purchase price or reluctance to admit a loss."]}
